stem.text: A wave of frequency $15\,\text{Hz}$ travels at $24\,\text{m s}^{-1}$ through a medium.
What is the phase difference between two points $2.0\,\text{m}$ apart?

B.text: They are out of phase by a quarter of a cycle.

C.text: They are out of phase by half a cycle.

D.text: They are out of phase by 0.80 of a cycle.
